source_evidence: Exact player 'Get cover' directs V to take cover with remaining movement after R3 Hide and Attack; treated as ending V turn once positioned, no new attack/reaction/resource use. V moves from(60,-20) approximately15ft around existing work shelter to(50,-30), upright, behind its southern wall; total cover vs northern archers/veteran where wall intervenes, no blanket cover vs all angles or new Hide (attack already revealed). No hostile within reach along path; no OA. Prepared camp morale trigger captain disabled, prior P7 surrender, three hostile casualties. P2 Scout at(65,0) chooses withdrawal rather than shoot, Dash west along clear camp route toward gate, ends(5,0) after60ft. P3 wounded Scout at(40,-30) also Dashes to gate and outside, ending roughly(-10,0) west of gate after up to60ft on 2014 ordinary grid movement; still alive HP9, actual visible departure, no confirmed onward route/arrival. P6 Scout leaves lookout via existing ladder15ft descent costing30 movement, Dash remaining30ft toward west gate ending approx(20,20), no attack or signal, still inside. All choose retreat via accessible west exit rather than attempt guarded culvert; intending to circle east once clear consistent with fixed retreat policy, not teleported to distant depot. P7 surrendered at gate, no renewed hostility. Cirren on R3 moves10ft to(65,-25), keeping veteran at(65,-5) outside Spirit Guardians radius15, and calls on him to drop weapons after his captain's death; does not spend spell or use another check, no Spirit Guardians damage/trigger because veteran remains20ft away and retreating scouts outside area. P1 Veteran recognizes operation's collapse, chooses survival under fixed morale surrender trigger, on own turn sets heavy crossbow down, agrees to disarm and surrenders, HP58 unchanged. Fenar R3 moves from(65,-30) to(65,-10) within5ft of surrendered veteran; orders his longsword/shortsword set aside, watches him while he complies voluntarily, no hostile strike, grapple or spending; Rage and Shift still active; prior Reckless effect ends start of her turn and not renewed. Weapons left on ground under Fenar's supervision, no assumed confiscation/transfer or tied custody, P7 still at gate unbound. Two laborers in shelter unharmed and unapproached. Round4 P7 remains surrendered at west gate, no attacks. V next at R4 initiative15. Still three retreating armed scouts (two inside/one just outside gate); potential pursuit or let them go, actual state not combat completed. No RNG because cover movement, Dash, and voluntary surrender are determined movement/independent prepared morale responses without uncertain attack, contested action or forced social check. All other resources unchanged; no automatic reward or knowledge of employer.
